    A NEW LIFE, A NEW SONG An Evening with HOVHANNES JOHN BABAKHANYAN

    8:30 PM · Catalina Jazz Club, Hollywood · $51.85 Algo especial

    Hovhannes John Babakhanyan is an award-winning Armenian actor and singer based in Los Angeles. Classically trained at the Komitas State Conservatory of Yerevan, he brings a rich, expressive voice and an actor's gift for storytelling to jazz standards and timeless pop classics. Singing in seven languages, he connects with audiences through music that crosses cultures and generations. His career spans theater, film, television, and concert stages, including more than 50 Hollywood projects and numerous international honors. Each performance reflects his passion for sharing stories, emotion, and the joy of music. Catalina Jazz Club 6725 West Sunset Blvd. Hollywood, CA 90028 *Two-item minimum required per person.

    Age 2 yrs+ require a ticket for entry A WEST COAST PREMIERE Wendy MacLeod's comedy, The Laugh Track, takes us behind the scenes of I Love Lucy. Based on the real-life experiences of Hollywood's first female TV writer, Madelyn Pugh, this play shines light on the inner workings of America's beloved sitcom and the woman who punched up the jokes, fought for her career, and paved the way for women in the writers room. Fast-paced and full of wit, The Laugh Track brings familiar characters to life, while proving that comedy is not a man's job.
